R, proofread, and export Markdown/SRT/VTT/JSON/HTML/DOCX.
# Douyin Export — DSH plugin
Download watermark-free Douyin (抖音) videos, transcribe them with local or cloud speech recognition,
proofread the text with a chat model, and export a formatted transcript in Markdown, TXT, SRT, VTT,
JSON, HTML or DOCX — one file per video, or one merged collection.
Built as a DSH plugin: it registers agent tools, a Skill, a confirmation action card, a scheduled-sy
nc entry and a web panel with per-task progress. The heavy lifting runs in a bundled Python engine.
## What it does
- **Fetch** — paste a video link, a video ID, a share text, a profile link or a raw `sec_uid`. Autho

rs sync incrementally: the sync stops as soon as it reaches videos it already has.
- **Download** —
saves the watermark-free MP4 (highest bitrate variant available) with ffprobe verification, then ext

racts a 16 kHz mono WAV for transcription.
- **Transcribe** — five interchangeable engines (two loca
l, three cloud). Per-video or batched, with per-task progress, pause-on-account-error circuit breaki

ng, and "no speech" detection so silent videos are skipped instead of failing.
- **Proofread** — an
optional chat model mines a `wrong → right` term table from a sample, you accept what is real, and t
he replacement is applied deterministically. Nothing is rewritten, timestamps are untouched. Per-occ
urrence fixes (`wrong => right || the sentence`) resolve homophones that only one sentence gets wron

g.
- **Export** — Markdown with YAML front-matter, plus TXT / SRT / VTT / JSON / HTML / DOCX. Option

al merged collection (MD/TXT/HTML/DOCX), newest first.
- **Tasks** — every run gets its own director
y (`video/`, `audio/`, `transcript/`, `export/<format>/`, `export/合集/`), a stage table (download / t

ranscribe / export) and a live progress snapshot.
- **Panel** — left-sidebar icon and a settings sec
tion. Tabs: New task, Tasks, Library (filter by author / task / status / keyword), Proofread, **Logi

n**, Settings.
- **Login tab** — one card per platform (currently Douyin and Xiaohongshu), each with
its own login state and QR code; adding a platform only means adding one entry to `PLATFORMS`.
## Requirements
| Need | Notes |
| DSH | any recent build; the plugin uses `ctx.tools`, `ctx.slots`, `ctx.skills`, `actionCards` and

`schedule` |
| Python | 3.10+ on `PATH` as `python` (or set `SV_PYTHON` / the `python` config key) |

| ffmpeg | `ffmpeg` + `ffprobe` on `PATH`, or set `media.ffmpegPath` |
| Browser | system Chrome or

Edge — the plugin drives it with Playwright for Douyin metadata |
| Cloud keys | only if you pick a
cloud engine; local SenseVoice needs no account |
Python packages are installed on first use of an engine and are **not** bundled:

## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Or from a local checkout, in DSH: Plugin Manager → install bundle → point at this directory.
## First run
1. Open **Settings & Login** → *Warm up / Login* if you want the browser cookie set ready. Scanning

the QR code once is enough; the profile persists, but **most downloads work without any login**.
2.
Local transcription needs a model: Settings → *Download model* (SenseVoice `int8`, ~228 MB) — or set

`asr.sensevoice.modelDir` to an existing directory.
3. Paste a link into **Tasks → New task** and p
ick what to do (download only, or download + transcribe + export).
> Authors with more than ~18 videos require a logged-in Douyin session to page further. That is a Do
uyin-side limit, not a plugin limit: the profile page shows "登录后查看更多作品" to anonymous visitors. `sv_l
ogin` opens a window, you scan once, and later syncs see the full list.
## Agent tools
| Tool | Purpose |
| `sv_run` | one-shot: fetch → download → transcribe → export for any mix of links, IDs and profile

links |
| `sv_sync` | sync one author's video list (incremental by default, `full` to rescan) |
| `s

v_download` | download watermark-free video for IDs or an author |
| `sv_transcribe` | transcribe do

wnloaded videos with a chosen engine |
| `sv_export` | export transcripts; per-video files and/or a

merged collection |
| `sv_polish` | mine term candidates, list terms, accept (global or per-occurren

ce), apply, reset |
| `sv_failures` | explain download / transcription failures by category, with re

try advice |
| `sv_library` | library stats, authors, and video lists |
| `sv_settings` | read/write

settings, list engines |
| `sv_login` | open the browser for a one-time QR login |
| `sv_job` | lis

t / inspect / cancel background jobs |
| `sv_subscribe` | register a scheduled incremental sync (DSH

el background jobs |
| `sv_subscribe` | register a scheduled incremental sync (DSH scheduled task) |
Long operations return a job id and keep running in the background; the panel shows their progress,
and `sv_job` reports from the agent side.
## Transcription engines
| Engine id | Where it runs | Timestamps | Needs |
| `sensevoice` | local CPU (int8) | sentence-level (from ffmpeg silence detection) | bundled-model d

ownload |
| `faster-whisper` | local CPU/GPU | word-level | `faster-whisper`, a model |
[该节后续省略]
## Privacy

- No key, path or account is shipped with the plugin; every default is empty.
- Keys you enter are w

ritten to `<home>/config.json` on your machine only, and are masked in every API response.
- Your me
dia and transcripts stay under `<home>`. The only outbound traffic besides Douyin itself is to the A
SR / chat endpoint **you** configure.
## Known limitations
- Douyin changes its front end often; the metadata path drives a real browser precisely because plai

n HTTP is blocked by the `a_bogus` / Argus signature chain.
- Anonymous profile pages are cut at rou

ghly 18 videos; log in once for the rest.
- Image-only posts (图集) have no video or audio — they are

marked `skipped` and listed in the task's failure explanation.
- Videos deleted or restricted upstre

am return 404/403 and cannot be recovered; `sv_failures` separates those from retryable cases.
- Clo
ud engines cost money on your own account, and a batch stops itself when the provider reports an acc
ount problem instead of burning the whole queue.
